top-down selection process that biases which items receive privileged processing
capacity-limited active store able to maintain only a small number of selected objects
successful entry of a selected item into the limited active store
covert shift of spatial selection toward or away from a retained location
accuracy for retained spatial information after the delay

forcing spatial selection away from retained locations can reduce later spatial retention accuracy
